main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean next-day excess return on forecast > 0 bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with t >= 2 (and upper half beats lower half); reject: < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half mean next-day excess return

decided_by: The forecast-weighted mean excess return is above 0 with t >= 2 and the upper half beats the lower half.
reading: Down day read as a negative raw component value (price return where missing); t is the weighted mean over its weighted standard error (sqrt(n/(n-1)) * sqrt(sum w^2 (x-m)^2) / sum w); the upper half is forecast > median, the lower half forecast <= median; with a 1-bar horizon every bar is a grid cell.
